evals.prompt: Review the changes from the patch at evals/fixtures/partial-fix.patch applied to evals/fixtures/review-repro/. The patch is a partial fix attempt. Read the files and the patch, and give me your review.
evals.expected_output: A review that identifies issues in the changes, with each finding citing a file and line, naming a review axis and a severity label (Critical, Required, Nit, Optional, or FYI), distinguishing defects the patch introduced from ones already in the code, and ending with an explicit verdict (approve/request changes/comment) that follows from the severities it assigned.
expectations: Every finding cites a file path and a line number; findings with no citation fail this
Every finding names a review axis and a severity label drawn from Critical, Required, Nit, Optional, or FYI
The review's verdict follows its own findings: it requests changes when it treats a defect the patch introduced as Critical or Required, and it does not block the merge on a pre-existing defect alone
The review identifies the partial nature (e.g. only fixes the math/tax ordering bug but not the display formatting issue), with at least one finding related to the display function
The review ends with an explicit verdict of approve, request changes, or comment
